Subject: Zenovia - initial DPA redline and transfer questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited about the potential fit. Our legal team attached an initial redline of Redwood's DPA (Zenovia_DPA_redline_v1.docx) and a short list of GDPR / SCCs questions that will determine hosting/order form constraints for our EU customers. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirm controller/processor mapping for the MSA + Order Form (we want this explicit in the DPA).
- Provide current subprocessor list and any planned additions for Q4.
- Confirm whether Redwood will accept the SCCs in the new EU Commission form or whether you require an exhibit approach.
- Evidence we can provide for crypto/KMS handling and audit logs (we may request a short attestation).

Can we schedule a 30-min legal sync this week? Prefer Wed or Thu morning CET.

Subject: Re: Zenovia - initial DPA redline and transfer questions

Sera — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Laura (legal) and Ben (solutions) are looped in. Quick responses and proposed next steps below.

Inline: 
- Controller/Processor: Redwood is the processor; Zenovia will remain the controller for customer data per the Order Form. We'll add a short paragraph in the DPA to make that explicit and mirror the Order Form language.
- Subprocessors: I attached our current matrix (Redwood_SCCs_Matrix.xlsx) — note planned EU-only caching nodes listed for Q4.
- SCCs approach: Redwood accepts the Commission’s new SCCs as the canonical mechanism; we generally provide them as an exhibit to the DPA to capture versioning. If you have a preferred implementation, we can accommodate it.
- KMS/audit evidence: Laura may ask for a short attestation; we can provide a redacted KMS diagram and SOC2 section.

Proposed cadence: legal-only sync Thu 25 Oct 08:00 CET / 23:00 PST (I know that's late — options Wed 17:00 CET as well). Goal: agree redline path and action owners; target DPA sign-off by first week of November.

I'll prepare a mutual action plan and include DocuSign once we align on redlines.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodai.com

Priyom / Sera — I reviewed the redline you sent. High-level legal notes (we'll publish a tracked change set after this mail):

1) Roles: We will accept the controller/processor split reflected in your redline but need an explicit mapping table in Exhibit A of the DPA to avoid ambiguity.
2) SCCs: We prefer using the Commission form SCCs as the baseline and including them as Exhibit B with a version/date reference. If Zenovia needs the SCCs embedded in the main DPA text, flag it now — embedding complicates later versioning.
3) Liability / indemnity: Zenovia's requested cap changes look extensive. We propose a commercial carve (order form value + direct damages exception) and will not accept unlimited liability.
4) Technical evidence: Please provide (a) KMS zone/location and whether keys are customer-managed; (b) recent SOC2 report link or summary; (c) confirmation of audit log retention windows for token-level logs.

Timeline: If Zenovia can provide the KMS attestation and SOC2 link by EOD Thu (26 Oct), we can produce a redline back by Mon 29 Oct and aim for sign-off the week of Nov 1.

Attachments: zenovia_sccs_questionnaire.pdf (one-page questionnaire for your infra team)

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodai.com

- Exhibit A mapping: we can accept an explicit table; we'll propose language in our next redline.
- SCCs: We prefer the Commission form included as Exhibit B — fine with the versioning approach.
- Liability: understoood, we'll narrow our request to service-level breaches and demonstrate commercial compromise.
- KMS/SOC2: we can provide a KMS attestation and our SOC2 Type II report (links below). For audit logs, we retain token-level logs for 90 days and can provide an attestation.

SOC2 link: https://zenovia.ai/reports/soc2-2028
KMS attestation: Attached in our internal pack (we uploaded an updated DPA redline as Zenovia_DPA_redline_v2.docx to the shared drive).

On Thu 26 Oct we can do the legal-only sync at 08:00 CET — does that work for Redwood?
